description: Generated by `void-machine init` — the Codex-side safety floor, mirror of the Claude Code PreToolUse hooks. Each command finds .void/hooks/ from the session directory, so the file holds no machine path; re-run `void-machine init` to refresh. See docs/CODEX.md.

hooks.command: node -e "const f=require('fs'),p=require('path'),u=require('url'),m=process.argv[1];let d=process.cwd(),h='',i=64;while(i--){const c=p.join(d,'.void','hooks','_void-hook.mjs');if(f.existsSync(c)){h=c;break}const n=p.dirname(d);if(n===d)break;d=n}if(h){process.argv.splice(1,0,h);import(u.pathToFileURL(h).href).catch(function(e){process.stderr.write('HOOK_RUNNER_FAILED: '+String(e)+String.fromCharCode(10));process.exitCode=m==='enforce'?2:0})}else{process.stderr.write('HOOK_RUNNER_MISSING: .void/hooks/_void-hook.mjs not found above '+process.cwd()+String.fromCharCode(10));process.exitCode=m==='enforce'?2:0}" enforce dangerous-command codex
